plans.idea: Classic landscape split: the sneaker sits big on the left half, and the right half is one aligned column with the brand pill on top, then the headline block, then the Enter the Draw button, all sharing one left edge.

The text leads: a left column reads top to bottom (brand pill, headline with sub-copy, CTA) on one shared left edge, and the sneaker fills the full-height right half so the eye moves from the message to the product.

Top/bottom bands: the brand pill sits in the top-left corner beside a wide sneaker across the upper right, and the lower band reads left to right from the headline block to the CTA button on the right.
